partnerPortal.clientBannerDesc: Café, bowling, restaurant or leisure activity: list your place on Tfarhida and reach thousands of local clients in Sfax and across Tunisia.
partnerPortal.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions by Venue Owners
partnerPortal.faqCommissionQ: Does Tfarhida charge commission on my clients?
partnerPortal.faqCommissionA: No, 0% commission. Your clients contact you and book directly on your WhatsApp or phone.
partnerPortal.faqPushQ: How do push notification quotas work?
partnerPortal.faqPushA: Pro pack includes 2 notifications/month and Premium includes 10/month to prevent spam and ensure maximum engagement.
partnerPortal.faqApprovalQ: How long does venue verification take?
partnerPortal.faqApprovalA: Once your email is verified with a 6-digit 2FA code, our team validates your venue within 24 business hours. You can also fast-track via direct WhatsApp.
